show.description: Kriti Malhotra, shrouded in secrets and vengeance, weaves her way into the lives of Aditya and his powerful father Vikram. As lies and half-truths entangle them, Aditya struggles to uncover her true identity, Himani, a woman thought to be lost forever. In a world driven by betrayal, greed, and revenge, every move Kriti makes threatens to shatter the Ahuja family, while Vikram, Nitin, and Anita fight to protect their own dark legacies. Watch Now!
